messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: NewBridge (dedicated pool eu2) seeing elevated tail latency. p95=820ms (SLO=300ms), p99=1.8s. Triggered auto-escalation after p99 > 1.5s for 3m. Link: https://console.redwood/incident/5180004321

mike-sre: Ack — I'm oncall for eu2, joining now.

sara-ops: On it, grabbing dashboards + recent deploys.

mike-sre: Quick triage question: is this pool-wide or tenant-scoped? @nina-cs can you check with NewBridge support?

nina-cs: NewBridge support confirms they kicked off a bulk import at ~10:05 UTC. They're seeing retries; asking them to pause the job.

liam-eng: Observability: tail concentrated to tenant nb-enterprise (tenant_id=nb-enterprise). That tenant is ~65% of request volume in eu2-main and correlates with KV cache churn. Suggest isolating tenant and enabling temporary rate cap.

mike-sre: Proposed mitigation plan (short):
1) create isolated shard for nb-enterprise (tenant-shunt)
2) spin warm spare node for isolated shard
3) reroute a portion of traffic to eu1 fallback model variant for soak
4) apply 429-based token throttling on nb-enterprise if needed

sara-ops: Executing tenant-shunt now: `opsctl tenant_shunt --tenant nb-enterprise --target isolated-eu2-1`

```
# tenant_shunt output
shunt created: isolated-eu2-1
drain started for nb-enterprise on pool eu2-main
```

oncall-alt: Warm spare boot OK, kube pods becoming ready. ETA ~90s to accept traffic.

incident-bot: Metrics update: after shunt start p99 -> 1.1s, p95 -> 460ms. (auto-sample interval 30s)

mike-sre: Good progress. @nina-cs please confirm NewBridge can pause heavy batch, request immediate pause.

nina-cs: They acknowledged and will pause bulk import within 2m.

liam-eng: Applied temporary KV bypass on isolated-eu2-1 to avoid cache eviction storms: `env REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=disabled` on that shard.

sara-ops: Rerouting ~35% of nb-enterprise traffic to eu1-fallback variant for soak. Current metrics: p99=0.62s, p95=240ms for the combined routing mix.

mike-sre: :white_check_mark: Service stabilized. Next actions: postmortem + capacity/shard plan. Assigning long-term owner: @liam-eng for shard separation and autoscale rule. @sara-ops to update NewBridge support with timeline.

nina-cs: Confirmed to customer: pause acknowledged, we'll notify when safe to resume.

incident-bot: :spiral_note_pad: Incident moved to monitoring at 5180004625. Follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-5180004321 (owner: liam-eng).
